why: DG2-RELICS: a short rooms dungeon whose secrets carry relics: a room with TWO cracked secrets (per-secret relic and lore), a room with one balcony secret (room-level params.relic / lore / relic_name), four variants (mirror, seed, an alternate record), a second cracked secret in the swapped room. A fixture for tests/test_dungeon_relics.py, not a dungeon anyone plays; every theme builds it.

secrets.lore: Somebody bricked this up in a hurry and left the lamp lit.
A tally of shifts, scratched in the stone by hands that stopped counting.

params.lore: Kept above the water line on purpose: whoever stood here wanted it seen and never reached.
